hooks.name: vehicle_damage
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's VehicleDamageEvent)

doc_summary: A player is about to damage a boat or minecart: `native_vehicle_damage(kind, damage, cancel)` may change the damage or cancel it before the vehicle's damage and wobble change; the attack still completes. Bundles need "hooks": @API:native_vehicle_damage@.
